svg.desc: The weight map from the Qwen3-0.6B checkpoint to d2l.Qwen3GPT: embed_tokens to token_emb; per layer input_layernorm to norm1, q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj to W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, q_norm and k_norm unchanged, post_attention_layernorm to norm2, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj to W_g, W_1, W_2; the final norm; lm_head is a copy of embed_tokens and is dropped. q_proj, k_proj, q_norm and k_norm are also permuted. Inset: for one head with d_h = 8, Transformers rotates pairs (i, i+4) and the book pairs (2i, 2i+1); the permutation is idx = [0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7].
